items.title: Theme
items.description: internet-ui design tokens (Tailwind v4). Import once from your global stylesheet.

items.name: ui-defaults
items.title: Variant defaults
items.description: Project-wide default radius and shadow. Values are substituted from the `defaults` block of internet-ui.json at install time.

items.description: clsx + tailwind-merge class combiner and shared radius variants used by every component.

items.title: Motion presets
